requirements.title: AI-assisted commit messages
requirements.description: When an operator requests a commit message, the system SHOULD collect exact staged evidence, offer full or disclosed partial reusable suggestions, and start a durable cancellable read-only drafting agent only on explicit request; accepting a suggestion SHOULD preserve operator edits and MUST NOT stage or commit files.

validation.notes: Race-enabled domain/store/proposal suites passed 60 top-level tests. Includes no-agent collection, durable same-key admission, lost acknowledgments, cancellation races, immutable input bounds, stale selection and strict result rejection. Related snapshot/matching tests prove index versus working bytes and conservative retained subsets.
Typed Connect and fake execution-owner lifecycle tests passed with isolated Git fixtures; real repository index and history were not modified.

Final full UI execution passed 566 tests across 67 files, including explicit start, partial accept without inference, cancellation, reconnect, staged applicability races and human edit/trailer preservation. Global coverage gate remains below its unchanged 85% target; this is not scenario certification.
Full CLI tests passed across 12 packages; typed collect/check/start/status/wait/cancel and generated primitive-evidence freshness verified.

Final selected browser run f263360d-9b16-4e82-9557-bd8fef239adc passed desktop and companion mobile observer cases. Actual screenshots inspected. Feature interaction is covered by component and API fixtures; no live paid model qualification was performed. AM unit/contracts run 20261022-032302-b40db304 passed; final workflow/profile hashes were read back after lifecycle activation. Implementation is delivered; formal requirement status remains in_progress because the broader GCT suite is not green and no run-coupled requirements-sync snapshot earns complete status.
